mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals tighter monetary conditions, which increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer and business spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive (>0) in more than 40% of cases when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points over 3 months signals labor market weakness, which may lead to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP (GDPC1) at an annualized rate exceeding 2.5% signals strong economic demand, which should drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative in more than 30% of cases when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When both real GDP (GDPC1) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) show concurrent growth, it signals a strong economic expansion that should drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative in more than 25% of cases when both GDPC1 and PAYEMS are growing, or the interaction term's t-statistic falls below 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% during a monetary tightening cycle signals increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns remain positive in more than 40% of cases when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A 5% year-over-year increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong supply-side activity, which should drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative in more than 30% of cases when INDPRO growth exceeds 5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When both real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) show concurrent growth, it signals a strong economic expansion that should drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative in more than 25% of cases when both GDPC1 and HOUST are growing, or the interaction term's t-statistic falls below 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points over 2 months during an early-cycle expansion signals improving labor market conditions, which should drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns remain negative in more than 40% of cases when UNRATE declines by >0.2pp, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.05.
